raw_segments.text: Banquo, good sir, why do you start and seem to fear things that do sound so fair?
I, T. H. name of truth, are ye fantastical, or that indeed which outwardly ye show?
My noble partner you greet with present grace and great prediction of noble having and of
royal hope, that he seems rapt withal.
If you can look into the seeds of time, and say which grain will grow, and which will
not, speak then to me, who neither beg nor fear your favors nor your hate.
